mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_posting ( title, employer, description, pay, pay_type, work_period, work_days, start_time, end_time, time_negotiable, location, contact, benefits, user_idx, region_idx, category, createdDate, IMGURL ) VALUES ( #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{employer, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{pay, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{payType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workPeriod, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{workDays, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{endTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{timeNegotiable, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{location, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contact, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{benefits, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userIdx}, #{regionIdx}, #{category, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{imgUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE job_posting SET title=#{title}, description=#{description}, pay=#{pay}, pay_type=#{payType}, work_period=#{workPeriod}, work_days=#{workDays}, start_time=#{startTime}, end_time=#{endTime}, time_negotiable=#{timeNegotiable}, location=#{location}, contact=#{contact}, benefits=#{benefits}, category=#{category} WHERE posting_idx = #{postingIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT posting_idx AS postingIdx, user_idx AS userIdx, region_idx AS regionIdx, pay_type AS payType, work_period AS workPeriod, work_days AS workDays, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, time_negotiable AS timeNegotiable, IMGURL AS imgUrl, title, employer, description, pay, location, contact, benefits, category, createdDate FROM job_posting WHERE posting_idx = #{postingIdx}
